description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno5_eno1_blend_norm_D2_extrapolate_bc, fire_behavior's fire_upwinding = 10 (Calc_tend_ls case 10). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge, the smallest even size on which every region is non-empty), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit byte-identical canonical bytes, which the golden pins: the COMPOUND gradient magnitude sqrt((D(u,x))^2 + (D(u,y))^2) (priority 20) replaced by the rule's body -- sqrt(Mx^2 + My^2) with Mx, My the family's per-axis frames (rules/weno5_eno1_D1x_extrapolate_frame, rules/weno5_eno1_D1y_extrapolate_frame) around stencils/weno5_eno1_blend_D1x_interior and stencils/weno5_eno1_blend_D1y_interior -- with all metaparameters folded and zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in the equations. The golden is the reference-preserving lowered form (esm-spec 9.6.4): match-less template references in the rule body (the frames, the interior and point stencils) survive as resolved apply_expression_template leaves and the imported template registry is part of the golden, so the golden pins the whole composition, not only the equations. Free names left symbolic: dx, dy, wind_u, wind_v, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells, pi_blend. This is the library's first smooth partition-of-unity operator, so the golden pins its composition: the three-branch cosine mask stencils/weno5_eno1_cosine_mask (exactly 1 for |u| <= B, the taper for B < |u| <= 2B, exactly 0 beyond), forced to 0 on the wall band, feeding stencils/weno5_eno1_masked_blend, which selects the ENO1 value where the mask is 0 -- and that pi_blend survives as a free name instead of being folded to a literal. wind_u = 1, wind_v = 0.5 constant fields; pi_blend = 3.1415926 (fire_behavior's truncated PI); bdy_eno1_cells = 3, weno_band_cells = 4 (parameters); x0=y0=0, dx=dy=1/8 spelled with the literal 8 (grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/grid.esm contract). The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings.
